description: A unit is one dwelling, suite or tenancy of a building that holds several (an apartment, a condo, a hotel room, a shop): a named group of rooms (zones) under the building. Its members may span levels (a duplex). A zone belongs to at most one unit; a zone in no unit is common area (a corridor, a lobby, the stairs). A single-family house has no units. List the units of a building, or of every building: id, name, kind, colour, member zone ids and a report (member count, the levels it spans, gross area, each member with its name, level and area).

buildingId.description: The building. Default: the building of the floor the person is viewing, else the scene's only building.
